thesis: KNSA is a rare stock with fundamentals and price both confirming strength in a hostile tape. Revenue growth is accelerating (+58.1% YoY), profits are rising, cash far exceeds debt, and dilution risk is low. The trend is clean (close above SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200) at a 52-week high, with no earnings event in the swing window and fresh analyst support (TD Cowen $115). The setup is only moderate, not compelling. Valuation is rich, the stock is extended, and the regime is risk-off with VIX at the 99th percentile. The bull case therefore depends on buying the pullback zone, not chasing, and on defensive-leaning healthcare rotation helping (XLV is a leading sector).
